name: context-handoff
description: Long sessions that don't run out of room: at a natural stopping point Claude writes a handoff, the session restarts on it and keeps working, with your exact words, skills and plan carried over.

softTokens.title: Soft threshold (tokens)
softTokens.description: Context size at which the model is asked to hand off at its next natural stopping point. Capped at 60% of the context window.

firmTokens.title: Firm threshold (tokens)
firmTokens.description: Context size at which the model is told to stop starting work and hand off now. Capped at 80% of the context window.
